/blog/accoya-wood-gates-london/.heading: Considering Accoya for your driveway gates?
/blog/accoya-wood-gates-london/.description: Tell us about the gate style, finish and upkeep you have in mind. Ask for a quote that separates the timber, gate construction and installation.

/blog/anthracite-grey-gate-trends-london.heading: Planning an anthracite gate finish?
/blog/anthracite-grey-gate-trends-london.description: Tell us which gate material you are considering and what it needs to match. Ask about colour samples, sheen and the finish included in your quote.

/blog/article-4-directions-gate-planning.heading: Planning gate work in an Article 4 area?
/blog/article-4-directions-gate-planning.description: Describe the gate changes you want and any restrictions the council has confirmed. Ask for a quote based on that scope; the planning authority must confirm permissions.

/blog/automated-gate-home-insurance/.heading: Need a quote for gate work your insurer has asked about?
/blog/automated-gate-home-insurance/.description: Tell us what your insurer needs and whether you are considering installation, repairs or replacement. We can discuss the gate work; your insurer decides cover and policy terms.

/blog/automated-gates-sloping-driveways-.heading: Working out which gates suit your sloping drive?
/blog/automated-gates-sloping-driveways-.description: Describe where the drive rises or falls and how you park. Ask about an entrance layout and installation quote that account for the slope, gate movement and drainage.

/blog/bi-fold-vs-sliding-gates-london/.heading: Comparing gates for a short driveway?
/blog/bi-fold-vs-sliding-gates-london/.description: Tell us about your parking space and the room beside the entrance. Ask for a quote based on a layout that allows for the full movement of folding or sliding gates.

/blog/conservation-area-gate-planning-lo.heading: Planning repairs or new gates in a conservation area?
/blog/conservation-area-gate-planning-lo.description: Tell us which original details you want to retain and what the council has advised. Ask about repair or replacement options that fit your frontage and the confirmed requirements.

/blog/do-i-need-a-dropped-kerb-for-a-dri.heading: Coordinating your gates with a vehicle crossing?
/blog/do-i-need-a-dropped-kerb-for-a-dri.description: Tell us whether your crossing is existing, new or being widened, and what the highway authority has confirmed. Ask for a gate quote that accounts for the entrance layout and sequence of work.

/blog/driveway-gate-property-value-londo.heading: Considering gates before selling or improving your home?
/blog/driveway-gate-property-value-londo.description: Tell us what you want to improve about the entrance and your budget. Ask for a quote based on appearance, access and upkeep, without relying on a promised increase in property value.

/blog/driveway-gates-noise-reduction-lon.heading: Considering gates for a noisy frontage?
/blog/driveway-gates-noise-reduction-lon.description: Describe the road, existing boundary and the change you want to make. Ask about gate design and installation costs; a gate quote alone cannot confirm a reduction in traffic noise.

/blog/electric-gate-parcel-delivery-acce.heading: Need a better delivery routine at your gates?
/blog/electric-gate-parcel-delivery-acce.description: Tell us where parcels should go and how you want to answer couriers. Ask about intercom or access-control changes that suit your existing gates and household routine.

/blog/front-garden-paving-suds-london/.heading: Planning paving and gate work together?
/blog/front-garden-paving-suds-london/.description: Tell us about the proposed surface, finished levels and drainage arrangements. Ask for a gate quote that coordinates foundations and cable routes with the driveway work.

/blog/gate-motor-humming-not-moving/.heading: Gate motor humming but the gate stays still?
/blog/gate-motor-humming-not-moving/.description: Tell us when the problem started and what you have already noticed, without trying the gate again. Ask about a repair assessment and the cost of investigating the fault.

/blog/gsm-gate-openers-london/.heading: Want to open your gates by phone?
/blog/gsm-gate-openers-london/.description: Tell us about your current gate controls, mobile signal at the entrance and who needs access. Ask about compatible phone-entry options, installation and ongoing SIM costs.

/blog/minimalist-steel-slat-gates-london.heading: Planning steel slat gates for your entrance?
/blog/minimalist-steel-slat-gates-london.description: Tell us how much privacy you want and which views need to stay clear. Ask for a quote that specifies the slat spacing, frame, finish and opening arrangement.

/blog/outward-swinging-gates-uk-rules/.heading: Unsure how your gates can open within the boundary?
/blog/outward-swinging-gates-uk-rules/.description: Describe the available space and any highway boundary information you have. Ask about alternative gate layouts; the relevant authority must confirm boundary and permission questions.

/blog/smart-gate-integration-ring-nest-c.heading: Want your gates to work with your smart-home system?
/blog/smart-gate-integration-ring-nest-c.description: Tell us which Ring, Nest or Control4 equipment you use and whether you need visitor calls, gate release or status information. Ask for a compatibility check within the proposed installation scope.

/blog/solar-powered-gate-automation-lond.heading: Considering solar power for your gates?
/blog/solar-powered-gate-automation-lond.description: Tell us about shade at the entrance, daily use and the equipment you want to power. Ask for a site-specific proposal that includes winter demand and backup arrangements.

/blog/telescopic-gates-space-saving-lond.heading: Short of space beside your gate opening?
/blog/telescopic-gates-space-saving-lond.description: Tell us the approximate opening width, available side space and parking layout. Ask whether telescopic gates are worth assessing and what the full installation quote would include.

/blog/tree-protection-orders-gate-instal.heading: Planning gate work near protected trees?
/blog/tree-protection-orders-gate-instal.description: Tell us where the trees stand and share any council or arboricultural advice you have. Ask for a gate proposal that accounts for those constraints before groundworks are agreed.

/blog/underground-gate-motors-london/.heading: Considering underground motors for your gates?
/blog/underground-gate-motors-london/.description: Tell us whether you have existing gates and what you know about drainage at the entrance. Ask for a quote that includes foundation boxes, access for servicing and the surrounding groundworks.

/blog/video-intercom-comelit-vs-hikvisio.heading: Comparing Comelit and Hikvision for your gate?
/blog/video-intercom-comelit-vs-hikvisio.description: Tell us about the existing wiring and where you want visitor calls to ring. Ask for a complete installed-system quote, including gate release, phone access and ongoing charges.

/blog/wrought-iron-gate-restoration-lond.heading: Want to restore your existing metal gates?
/blog/wrought-iron-gate-restoration-lond.description: Describe the rust, damaged fittings or original details you want to keep. Ask about an assessment and a repair quote that separates metalwork, preparation and finishing.

/guides/aluminium-vs-wooden-driveway-gat.heading: Choosing between aluminium and timber gates?
/guides/aluminium-vs-wooden-driveway-gat.description: Tell us the appearance you want, the upkeep you can manage and your approximate opening size. Ask for comparable quotes covering the same entrance and installation scope.

/guides/automation-kit-installation-pric.heading: Budgeting to automate the gates you already have?
/guides/automation-kit-installation-pric.description: Tell us about the existing gates, supports and nearby power supply. Ask for a retrofit quote that includes the condition assessment, controls and work around the motors.

/guides/best-intercom-systems/.heading: Need an intercom that suits your household?
/guides/best-intercom-systems/.description: Tell us who should answer visitors and whether you prefer a screen, phone or both. Ask about equipment and installation options for your gate and available connections.

/guides/electric-driveway-gates-cost-lon.heading: Need a cost for your own entrance?
/guides/electric-driveway-gates-cost-lon.description: Tell us the approximate opening size, gate style and whether you need a new installation or retrofit. Ask for an itemised quote covering the gate, power, groundworks and controls.

/guides/electric-gate-running-costs/.heading: Concerned about the cost of running your gates?
/guides/electric-gate-running-costs/.description: Tell us about your gate equipment and whether you are considering servicing or an upgrade. Ask about the work and ownership costs to compare before replacing equipment.

/guides/force-testing-explained/.heading: Need to discuss force testing for your gates?
/guides/force-testing-explained/.description: Tell us about the installation, any recent changes and the records you hold. Ask what a safety assessment would cover, which tests are appropriate and what the quoted work includes.

/guides/how-to-manually-open-electric-ga.heading: Need help with your gate’s manual release?
/guides/how-to-manually-open-electric-ga.description: Tell us the operator model if you know it and whether you are dealing with a power cut, a missing key or a release fault. Ask about assistance without forcing the gate or dismantling the operator.

/guides/photocells-vs-safety-edges/.heading: Unsure which protection your gates need?
/guides/photocells-vs-safety-edges/.description: Tell us about the existing devices and any change in gate behaviour. Ask about an assessment of the whole entrance and a quote for any recommended work.

/guides/swing-vs-sliding-gates/.heading: Not sure which opening layout fits your driveway?
/guides/swing-vs-sliding-gates/.description: Tell us about the opening width, parking position and available side space. Ask for a layout assessment and quote that account for gate travel, slopes and walking access.

/guides/uk-electric-gate-safety-laws/.heading: Need help assessing your existing electric gates?
/guides/uk-electric-gate-safety-laws/.description: Tell us who uses the entrance, any concerns and which handover or service records you have. Ask what an assessment includes and what documentation comes with the quoted work.

/guides/winter-gate-maintenance/.heading: Preparing your gates for wet and cold weather?
/guides/winter-gate-maintenance/.description: Tell us about the last service and any changes you have already noticed. Ask for a maintenance quote that covers your equipment, drainage concerns and manual-release arrangements.

/guides/driveway-home-security/.heading: Want to improve security at your entrance?
/guides/driveway-home-security/.description: Tell us about your existing gates, the access you need and the concern you want to address. Ask about gate repairs, replacement or access-control improvements that fit your driveway.

/blog/repair-electric-gates-installed-by.heading: Need help with gates fitted by another company?
/blog/repair-electric-gates-installed-by.description: Tell us the make if you know it, what has gone wrong and which records you have. Ask whether your equipment can be assessed and what an initial repair visit would cost.

/blog/electric-gates-open-but-wont-close.heading: Need help with gates that won’t close?
/blog/electric-gates-open-but-wont-close.description: Describe whether the gates stay still, start closing or reverse, using what you have already observed. Ask about investigating the fault and the repair work your entrance may need.

/blog/electric-gates-keep-breaking-down-.heading: Unsure whether another gate repair is worthwhile?
/blog/electric-gates-keep-breaking-down-.description: Tell us about the recurring faults and previous repairs. Ask for an assessment and itemised options so you can compare another repair with partial or complete replacement.

/blog/replace-gate-automation-without-re.heading: Want new automation while keeping your gates?
/blog/replace-gate-automation-without-re.description: Tell us which gate leaves and controls you want to retain. Ask for a replacement-automation quote that includes compatibility, condition checks and any supporting work.

/blog/electric-gate-remote-not-working/.heading: Need help with a gate remote that has stopped working?
/blog/electric-gate-remote-not-working/.description: Tell us whether one or all handsets are affected and which other controls still work. Ask about checking the handset, receiver and gate system before buying replacement parts.

/blog/gate-intercom-rings-but-wont-open/.heading: Intercom calls through but won’t open the gate?
/blog/gate-intercom-rings-but-wont-open/.description: Tell us what happens when you request entry and whether another control still opens the gate. Ask about investigating the release fault before deciding to repair or replace the intercom.

/blog/only-one-electric-gate-opens/.heading: Need help getting both gate leaves working?
/blog/only-one-electric-gate-opens/.description: Tell us which leaf stays still, which control you used and whether the behaviour has changed. Ask about investigating the single-leaf fault before replacing a motor.

/blog/electric-gates-stop-halfway-or-kee.heading: Gates stopping halfway or reversing?
/blog/electric-gates-stop-halfway-or-kee.description: Tell us where the movement stops and what happens next, using what you have already observed. Ask about investigating the fault and the repair work your gates may need.

/blog/electric-gates-not-working-after-r.heading: Gates stopped working after rain?
/blog/electric-gates-not-working-after-r.description: Tell us what stopped working and where you noticed water. Ask about investigating the rain-related fault and the repair work your gates may need.

/blog/electric-gates-keep-tripping-elect.heading: Gates keep tripping the electrics?
/blog/electric-gates-keep-tripping-elect.description: Tell us when the trips happen and what the gate was doing. Ask about investigating the fault and the repair work your gates may need.
